question: Should ClawHub add a consolidated skills namespace, and what root-command aliases or deprecation window should remain for existing users?
rationale: This changes user-facing CLI structure and compatibility, and source inspection shows current main has not already made the requested taxonomy decision.

options.title: Define namespace and compatibility plan
options.body: Choose singular or plural naming, keep root aliases or warnings as needed, and implement the migration with docs and tests.

options.title: Keep root commands as canonical
options.body: Leave the current root skill commands supported and close the taxonomy request only by explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Defer to a CLI vNext sweep
options.body: Keep this issue open as a CLI taxonomy tracker until a broader breaking-change window is planned.

recommendation.title: Define namespace and compatibility plan
recommendation.body: Choose singular or plural naming, keep root aliases or warnings as needed, and implement the migration with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the request and has the strongest recent history on the current CLI command registration and docs surface.
